business_problem: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank needed a scalable, contactless way to deliver personalized wealth-management guidance and everyday banking service to a very large retail customer base without forcing customers to wait for human staff.
solution_summary: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank and Baidu AI Cloud built Xiaopu as a digital employee that spans the bank app, online banking and service terminals. The implementation starts with a 3D twin of a real wealth manager, using high-precision body capture, voice cloning and text-to-speech so the avatar can speak naturally, while facial-expression recognition and full-duplex speech let customers interrupt and continue multi-turn conversations hands-free. Behind the avatar, Baidu AI Cloud's AI middle-platform and knowledge middle-platform combine user profiles, risk preferences, product knowledge, recommendation logic and accumulated dialogue records into a one-to-one advisory workflow. The system continuously learns from conversation data, improves customer-intent understanding and recommendations over time, and extends the same stack into the bank's broader future-bank concept so digital staff can front sales, service and advisory scenarios across multiple devices.

solution_components.name: AI Middle Platform Solution
solution_components.role: Coordinates speech, semantic analysis and service logic for the digital employee experience.

solution_components.name: Smart Finance Solution
solution_components.role: Packages the bank's digital-human service flows for advisory and branch scenarios.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the closed loop from knowledge production to knowledge application for bank service and advisory tasks.

solution_components.name: High-Precision User Profiling
solution_components.role: Builds individualized customer portraits and preference signals for one-to-one recommendations.

solution_components.name: Smart Recommendation Engine
solution_components.role: Matches products and asset-allocation suggestions to each customer's goals and risk tolerance.

data_flow: Customer voice and profile inputs from the mobile app, online banking and terminal channels flow into Xiaopu's digital-human interface, where acoustic and semantic analysis call the AI middle platform, user-profile and recommendation services, and the knowledge middle platform returns tailored answers and product suggestions.
business_outcome: The bank introduced a reusable digital-human service channel that scaled personalized advisory and service interactions, diverted most routine traffic from human agents and created a foundation for broader future-bank automation.
metrics: Voice-based Xiaopu customer service handled more than 80% of total service volume.
If Xiaopu serves 10,000 customers per day for 20 minutes each, it saves 3,333 labor hours per day.
The same scenario saves about 416 person-days per day and nearly 10,000 person-days per month.
